enEffect: In locations with a light level below 5, you gain Night Vision; in locations with a light level above 5, you are immune to Blindness.
Each time you gain an effect or an existing effect is refreshed, you gain 1/2/3 points of maximum health. The maximum health increase lasts 1 minute, up to a maximum of 30 points.

The duration of beneficial effects you gain is increased by 100%.
Synergy: [Prototype Chaotic] If you have the Prototype Chaotic enchantment equipped, the duration of beneficial effects you gain is increased by another 100%, and all negative effects you have that can be cured by milk are removed when you gain a beneficial effect.

Attacks from common undead creatures are reduced by 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%, attacks from other undead creatures are reduced by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%, and damage from the Wither is reduced by 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%. However, attacks from undead creatures have a 5%/4%/3%/2%/1% chance to trigger the “Curse of Undead” negative effect.

You are immune to Poison, fall damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, explosion damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, and fire damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%. When you are attacked, this enchantment indiscriminately releases the 6s “Lightburn Fungal Infection” negative effect around you, with a 25%/37.5%/50% chance to successfully inflict the negative effect.
If another player dies near you, you will die along with them.

The duration of all negative effects you receive is extended by 100%/90%/80%, damage taken is increased by 100%/90%/80%, up to a maximum of 10 points, but experience you gain is increased by 50%/65%/80%.
Damage you deal is reduced by 4/3/2 points, but experience you gain is increased by 10%/15%/20%.
Attacking a monster that has just attacked you increases your damage by 2/4/6 points for 10 seconds; this enchantment's “attack” detection window is 1.2/1.4/1.6s.

For 40 seconds after you respawn, your movement speed is increased by 8.33%, attack damage is increased by 25%, and attack speed is increased by 8.33%. For every 1 level by which your armor's accumulated enchantment level is higher, this enchantment's effect is increased by 100%.
